"""Repro for ticket #33199: Query.change_aliases AssertionError on qs1 | qs2."""
import sys, traceback

sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-15128-panel")

import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth", "bugapp"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection


class Foo(models.Model):
    qux = models.ForeignKey("bugapp.Qux", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="foos")

    class Meta:
        app_label = "bugapp"


class Bar(models.Model):
    foo = models.ForeignKey("bugapp.Foo", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="bars")
    another_foo = models.ForeignKey("bugapp.Foo", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="other_bars")
    baz = models.ForeignKey("bugapp.Baz", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="bars")

    class Meta:
        app_label = "bugapp"


class Baz(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        app_label = "bugapp"


class Qux(models.Model):
    bazes = models.ManyToManyField("bugapp.Baz", related_name="quxes")

    class Meta:
        app_label = "bugapp"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    for m in (Qux, Baz, Foo, Bar, Qux.bazes.through):
        se.create_model(m)

from django.db.models import Q

qux = Qux.objects.create()
qs1 = qux.foos.all()
qs2 = Foo.objects.filter(
    Q(bars__baz__in=qux.bazes.all()) | Q(other_bars__baz__in=qux.bazes.all())
)

print("rhs alias_map:", list(qs2.query.alias_map))
print("lhs table_map:", qs1.query.table_map)

# Case 1: works fine (per ticket)
try:
    list(qs2 | qs1)
    print("qs2 | qs1 -> OK")
except AssertionError:
    print("qs2 | qs1 -> AssertionError (unexpected)")
    traceback.print_exc()

# Case 2: AssertionError per ticket
try:
    list(qs1 | qs2)
    print("qs1 | qs2 -> OK")
except AssertionError:
    print("qs1 | qs2 -> AssertionError (BUG REPRODUCED)")
    traceback.print_exc()
    sys.exit(1)
